en: A black‑and‑white, slightly elevated view over a small town area with a prominent two‑storey classical building in the center, facing a landscaped park with paths, lawns, benches, and trees. Additional townhouses with metal roofs surround the main building, and forested hills with scattered houses can be seen in the background. Printed text at the top identifies the scene as the railway station in Motala.
